text: Each modal carries several meanings. Can: ability, informal permission, general possibility. Could: past ability and polite requests. May: formal permission, or about fifty per cent possibility. Might: a weaker possibility. Will: future, willingness, promise. Would: polite offers, past habits and unreal situations. Shall: offers and suggestions with I and we. Should: advice. Must: strong obligation, or a confident deduction. So the safe method in the exam: read the whole sentence, name the meaning you need, and only then choose the word.
